title: Admin Login Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection
impact: An attacker could bypass authentication to gain unauthorized administrative access without valid credentials.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements, enforce input validation, and apply secure authentication mechanisms.

title: UNION-Based SQL Injection ? Data Extraction
impact: Unauthorized retrieval of user information, including email addresses, via the Product Search API.
remediation: Implement parameterized queries, enforce input validation, and restrict database access through least-privilege permissions.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Execution of arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser through a specially crafted URL.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding, sanitize untrusted HTML, and enforce a Content Security Policy.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Stored malicious content may execute JavaScript in other users' browsers when they view the saved feedback.
remediation: Use an up-to-date HTML sanitization library, apply context-aware output encoding, and enforce a Content Security Policy.
